definitions.full: H2469. Chelday חֶלְדַּי proper name, masculine 1. one of David's heroes 1Chr 27:15 (= חֵלֶד 11:30 = חֵלֶב 2Sam 23:29 ) ᵐ5 Ξολδεια ( +? ), ᵐ5 L Ολδια . 2 a returned exile Zech 6:10 (omitted by ᵐ5 ) = חֵלֶם 6:14 .
